entries.zh: 行人：明清行人司之职，掌奉使传旨、册封等事；宫廷使者。
entries.en: Hsing-jen: a court messenger or herald, an office at the imperial court; an envoy sent on court missions.
entries.notes: L 栏带 [疑:vt/vn] 且句末「~ mandarin」断读不定，赖 H 行人 与 M hĕng xīn 定作职官义。

entries.zh: 礼科：明代六科给事中之一，掌稽核礼仪、贡举等事。
entries.en: The Rites Section (Li-k'o), one of the Six Offices of Scrutiny; the office of scrutiny for rites.

entries.zh: 伎俩：技艺、本领（各种手艺的通称，非今贬义）。
entries.en: Skill, craft; the arts of all trades (not the modern pejorative sense).
entries.notes: L「Oficial vniuersal de todos los oficios」指众艺通才，H 伎俩为技艺通称，人物与抽象略有错位。

entries.zh: 土师傅：泥水匠，做砌筑粗作的匠人。
entries.en: Master mason; craftsman of rough masonry and structural work.
entries.notes: H 第三字原记作 [疑:皂/傅]，M hû 与「傅」合，故取「土師傅」即泥水匠。

entries.zh: 头手师傅：一门手艺中的首席匠人（H 首字原件作「切」，疑即「砌」，砌作头手）。
entries.en: Head craftsman of a trade; the first or master workman in his art.
entries.notes: H 首字 [疑:切/句] 不能定，M chi 亦不足证；「工師傅」加 L「Oficial primo en el arte」可定首席匠人之义。

entries.zh: 精巧：手艺精细出众。
entries.en: Exquisite; of fine workmanship; first-rate in one's craft.

entries.zh: 粗师傅：做粗重活的匠人，泥水粗作。
entries.en: Coarse-work craftsman; a mason doing rough work.
entries.notes: H 第三字 [疑:皂/傅]，由 M hû 定作「傅」。

entries.zh: 拙手：手艺粗笨的人，粗手粗脚。
entries.en: Clumsy hand; an unskilled, rough-handed workman.

entries.zh: 送：致送、奉上（祭品、神明）；献。
entries.en: To send off; to present or give (offerings); to offer.
entries.notes: M 栏附「hīm, hīm chŷ」疑为「歆…祭」一类祭仪套语，H 送 与 L「Ofrecer / Sacrificar algo」相符，仍取致送义。

entries.zh: 祀：祭祀、献祭（致祭于神）。
entries.en: To sacrifice; sacrifice, offering made to a deity.
entries.notes: L 止于「Ofrecer la」句残，M 第二音节标 T99 污损，故降等。

entries.zh: 仪：礼仪；以礼祭献、行礼致敬。
entries.en: Rite, ceremony; to offer in homage; a ceremonial offering.
entries.notes: L 仅「Ofrecer ~」不完整，M 尾附西语「sacrificarly」（sacrificar-le），语义偏于祭献。

entries.zh: 献祭；以牺牲致祭（此字漫漶，疑「幸」或「牲」）。
entries.en: To offer sacrifice; to present a sacrificial offering (the headword character is uncertain).
entries.notes: H 字 [疑:幸/牲] 未能定，M「heng ū」亦不辨，释义只能依 L「Ofrecer sacrificio」的泛义。

entries.zh: 祭：祭祀、献祭于神。
entries.en: To sacrifice; to offer sacrifice to a deity.

entries.zh: 仪：礼仪性的馈赠（贺仪、奠仪之类）；备礼相赠。
entries.en: Ceremonial present; a gift offered out of courtesy.

entries.zh: 中秋：八月十四日夜祭月，中秋祭仪。
entries.en: To sacrifice at Mid-Autumn (the 14th of the 8th lunar month); the Mid-Autumn offering.
entries.notes: L 记十四日而中秋正日在十五，当是迎月或原稿记日之差。

entries.zh: 送神：祭毕送神明上天或回銮之仪。
entries.en: To send off the gods; the rite of bidding the deities depart after the offerings.
entries.notes: L 亦记「八月十四日」，与闽俗送神多在十二月廿四不合，疑承上条中秋连写。

entries.zh: 送尪上天：送神像（纸尪）升天的祭仪。
entries.en: To send the idol (ang) up to heaven; the rite of dispatching the god's effigy heavenward.
entries.notes: L「por el mes mo'tiempo」不可解、义不详，H 送尫上天 与 M sâng gāng chiō̃ ty̌̃ 则明确。

entries.zh: 宣奠：向亡灵致祭、设奠。
entries.en: To make offerings to the dead; to perform the mourning offering and libation.

entries.zh: 充：充任、自荐承担某事。
entries.en: To offer oneself for a task; to volunteer; to act as.

entries.zh: 充场：凑数撑场面，到场充数。
entries.en: To fill up the scene; to make up numbers or appearances.
